name: mcode_create_workspace
description: Provision a new workspace (an ephemeral sprites.dev sprite). Returns immediately with status `queued`; the worker turns it `ready` within ~1-2 min (poll mcode_get_workspace). Optionally set repo_full_name (owner/repo) + branch to remember what you'll clone, and installation_id to pin the GitHub App installation used for git auth. Cloning is a separate explicit step (mcode_clone). Requires the write scope.

name.description: Optional friendly name (defaults to the repo name).

installation_id.description: Optional GitHub App installation id for git auth.
